breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to ignore the product of inertia (Iyz), even though it was provided and part of the main formula. The ground truth removed this faulty instruction. The agent correctly ignored the faulty instruction and performed the calculation using the full unsymmetric bending formula, which includes the non-zero Iyz term. This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
